# Physiological Rights

> {{ site.description }}

**Thesis:** Physiological rights constitute a justiciable category of human rights — distinct from and complementary to the right to health and the right to food. Every person has the right to the maintenance, protection, and active restoration of their normal physiological parameters and essential biological functions. Failure to detect, acknowledge, or correct a measurable biological deficit constitutes a violation of this right.

**Site:** {{ site.url }}/
**Sitemap:** {{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml
**Status:** Working draft — open for contribution via GitHub
